title: POST /tournaments/:id/rounds/:n/boards/:pairing/history/:entry/undo response
description: The result change was undone (the board is back to what it held before) and the undo is an entry of its own in the history. Refused with 409 undo_refused and the reason as the message (error.schema.json); 404 entry_not_found for an entry that is not about this board; 404 board_gone.
